questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar uses a private sharing model for Cases. Each product line has several product specialists who want to have visibility to all Cases involving their product line. How should the administrator meet this requirement?

options.text: Create a predefined Case Team for each group of product specialists and assign the team using Case Assignment Rules.
Change the organization-wide default for Cases to Public Read/Write.
Give the product specialists' profile the View All permission on Cases.
Add a Product Line field to the Case page layout.

quotes: Ursa Major Solar uses a private sharing model for Cases. Each product line has several product specialists who want to have visibility to all Cases involving their product line. How should the administrator meet this requirement?
Create a predefined Case Team for each group of product specialists and assign the team using Case Assignment Rules.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar has three Account record types: Prospect, Customer, and Vendor. The Customer record type is only for Accounts that have a Closed Won Opportunity. How should a System Administrator prevent users from selecting the Customer record type when they create new Account records?

options.text: Remove the Customer record type as an assigned record type in the users' profiles and permission sets.
Set the Prospect record type as the default record type in the users' profiles.
Remove the Record Type field from the Account page layout.
Delete the Customer record type and create it again when an Opportunity is Closed Won.

quotes: Ursa Major Solar has three Account record types: Prospect, Customer, and Vendor. The Customer record type is only for Accounts that have a Closed Won Opportunity. How should a System Administrator prevent users from selecting the Customer Record Type when they create new Account records?
Remove the Customer record type as an Assigned record type in the users' profiles and permission sets.

questions.stem: A delegated administrator at Ursa Major Solar cannot edit the Created Date field for the Account record. What reason should the administrator give for why this is occurring?

options.text: Created Date is a system audit field, and it is read-only for existing records.
The delegated administrator needs the Modify All Data permission to edit the field.
The field is hidden from the page layout assigned to the delegated administrator.
Created Date is a formula field that is recalculated every time the record is saved.

quotes: A delegated administrator at Ursa Major Solar cannot edit the Created Date field for the Account record.
What reason should the administrator give for why this is occurring?
